rules.name: Fanatical Doctrines
rules.description:
SAN'SHYUUM models from your army have the following ability. **Voice of the Great Journey:**
At the start of any phase, this model can issue one Fanatical Doctrine it has not issued this turn to one friendly COVENANT INFANTRY unit within 6" that is not affected by a Fanatical Doctrine. Until the end of the phase, that unit is affected by that Doctrine. Each SAN'SHYUUM model can issue one Fanatical Doctrine per phase. A unit can be affected by one Caste Doctrine and one Fanatical Doctrine at the same time. **Shielded by Faith:**
Models in this unit have a 4+ invulnerable save. **Claim the Sacred Path:** Add 2 to the OC characteristic of models in this unit. **Armour of the Faithful:** Improve the Sv characteristic of models in this unit by 1 (to a maximum of 2+).

rules.name: Devoted Sergeants
rules.description:
UNGGOY Sergeant models from your army have the following ability. **Fanatical Preacher:**
At the start of any phase, instead of issuing a Caste Doctrine this battle round, this model can issue one Fanatical Doctrine to its unit.

rules.name: Integrated Battle Groups
rules.description:
Line Elements are friendly COVENANT INFANTRY and MOUNTED units. Support Elements are friendly COVENANT VEHICLE and MONSTER units.

After a Line Element has made its attacks, select one enemy unit it hit: that unit is Designated until the end of the phase. After a Support Element has made its attacks, select one enemy unit it hit: that unit is Suppressed until the end of the phase.

Each time a model in a Support Element attacks a Designated unit, add 1 to the hit roll. Each time a model in a Line Element attacks a Suppressed unit, improve the AP characteristic of that attack by 1.

rules.name: Worthy Foe
rules.description:
At the start of your Command phase, select one unit from your opponent's army that has the CHARACTER, MONSTER or VEHICLE keyword, is within range of an objective marker, or is your opponent's Warlord's unit. Until the start of your next Command phase, that enemy unit is your Worthy Foe.

Each time a SANGHEILI model attacks your Worthy Foe, re-roll a hit roll of 1 and a wound roll of 1. SANGHEILI units can re-roll charge rolls made against your Worthy Foe.

rules.name: Exultant
rules.description:
After a SANGHEILI unit destroys your Worthy Foe, that unit immediately resolves Regenerating Shields and is Exultant until the end of your next turn.

While a unit is Exultant, it is eligible to shoot and declare a charge in a turn in which it made an advance or fall-back move.

rules.name: Pack Encirclement
rules.description:
JIRALHANAE units can re-roll charge rolls made against an enemy unit that is within engagement range of one or more other friendly COVENANT units.

Each time a JIRALHANAE unit makes melee attacks against an enemy unit that is within engagement range of one or more other friendly COVENANT units, add 1 to the A characteristic of melee weapons equipped by models in that JIRALHANAE unit until it has finished making those attacks.

rules.name: Scuttle to Cover
rules.description: Once per battle round, each time a friendly YIG-YAR unit is selected as the target of one or more ranged attacks, before those attacks are made, it can make a normal move of up to D6+2". The attacking unit can then select new targets for any of its attacks. Each YIG-YAR unit can do this once per battle round.

rules.name: Invasion Vessels
rules.description: For this Detachment, friendly Spirit, Phantom, Lich and Kraken units are Invasion Vessels.

rules.name: Planetfall Operations
rules.description:
After a friendly COVENANT unit disembarks from an Invasion Vessel during your Movement phase, it can make a normal move of up to 3". Until the start of your next Command phase, that unit is a Landing Force.

Add 1 to the OC characteristic of models in Landing Force units.

rules.name: Fleet Command Network
rules.description: A Sangheili Shipmaster embarked within an Invasion Vessel can use Shipmaster's Command and Glassing Beam. When it does, measure distances and determine visibility from any friendly Invasion Vessel on the battlefield.

rules.name: Shadow Cell Units
rules.description: For this Detachment, Shadow Cell units are units with the Special Operations, Ranger, Assassin or Blademaster keyword, and Rtas 'Vadum's unit. Sergeant and Auxiliary keywords do not make their parent unit eligible.

rules.name: Active Camouflage Network
rules.description: At the end of your turn, select one friendly Shadow Cell unit that is unengaged. Until the start of your next turn, or just after that unit shoots or fights, whichever comes first, it is Concealed. While a unit is Concealed, it can only be selected as the target of a ranged attack if the attacking model is within 18".

rules.name: Armored Spearhead Units
rules.description: For this Detachment, an Armored Spearhead unit is a friendly COVENANT VEHICLE or MOUNTED unit, excluding AIRCRAFT and TITANIC units.

rules.name: Shielded Formation
rules.description: Each time a model in an Armored Spearhead unit resolves Regenerating Shields, if its unit is within 6" of another friendly Armored Spearhead unit, that model regains 1 additional lost SP. While an Armored Spearhead model has one or more SP, add 1 to its OC characteristic.

rules.name: Replacement Drafts
rules.description: At the end of your Command phase, select one friendly Grunt Cadre unit that is below starting strength. Return up to D3+2 destroyed Unggoy Warrior models to that unit. Sergeant, Auxiliary and CHARACTER models cannot be returned using this rule.

rules.name: Distributed Swarm-mind
rules.description: When determining whether a DRONE SWARM unit contains six or more models for its Swarming Flight ability, if that unit is within 6" of another friendly Drone Swarm, count the models in both units. Once per battle round, just after a Yanme'e Major issues a Yanme'e Caste Doctrine to its unit, select one other friendly Drone Swarm within 6" that is not affected by a Caste Doctrine. Until the end of the phase, that unit is affected by the same Doctrine.

rules.name: Colony Bonds
rules.description: During Declare Battle Formations, you can organise friendly MGALEKGOLO units into bonds of two. Each unit can have only one Bondmate. Each time a MGALEKGOLO unit attacks an enemy unit that was hit by its Bondmate earlier in the same phase, re-roll hit rolls of 1 and wound rolls of 1. When a MGALEKGOLO unit's Bondmate is destroyed, add 1 to the A characteristic of weapons equipped by models in the surviving unit for the remainder of the battle.

rules.name: Reclamation Sites
rules.description: Whenever a VEHICLE or FORTIFICATION unit is destroyed, before removing its last model, place a Reclamation marker as close as possible to the centre of that model. At the end of your Movement phase, one friendly HURAGOK model within 3" of a Reclamation marker can reclaim it. Remove that marker and select one: one friendly COVENANT VEHICLE or FORTIFICATION model within 6" regains up to D3+2 lost wounds or D3+2 lost SP; or you gain 1CP. Only one Reclamation marker can be reclaimed per battle round. Reclamation markers are not objective markers or terrain features.

sharedRules.name: Caste Hierarchy
sharedRules.description:
​

**Sergeants:**
A Sergeant model's entry lists the Caste Doctrines it can issue. **Auxiliaries:**
A unit can include Auxiliary models at the rate printed on its datasheet (for example, for every 5 Unggoy Warriors, 1 Sangheili Auxiliary or up to 2 Yig-Yar Auxiliaries). There is one Auxiliary entry per species: Sangheili, Jiralhanae, Yig-Yar, T'vaoan, Unggoy, Huragok and Yanme'e. T'vaoan Auxiliaries have the YIG-YAR keyword, so they can be taken wherever Yig-Yar Auxiliaries can. Each Auxiliary model can take one Specialist ability from its entry, at the points shown. **Keywords:**
A unit's keywords are those on its datasheet. Sergeant and Auxiliary models do not add their keywords to their unit, but rules can still affect a model by its own keywords. **Toughness:**
A unit's T characteristic is the one that the most models in it have. If two or more are tied, use the lowest. **Issuing Caste Doctrines:**
Once per battle round, at the start of any phase, each Sergeant model from your army can issue one Caste Doctrine from its entry to its unit. Unless otherwise stated, a unit can be affected by only one Caste Doctrine at a time.

sharedRules.name: Shielding Trait
sharedRules.description:
A model with an SP characteristic has Shields and starts the battle with that many Shield Points (SP). **Shield Save:**
Each time a model with 1 or more SP fails a save roll, determine the attack's Damage, then roll one D6. ■ 3+: the shield absorbs the attack. Subtract its Damage from the model's SP instead of its wounds; any excess is inflicted on its wounds. ■ 1–2: the shield is bypassed. All of the attack's Damage is inflicted on the model's wounds and its SP are not reduced. **Regenerating Shields:**
At the start of your Command phase, each unit with Shields regains D3 lost SP (D3+1 for VEHICLE and MOUNTED units, unless its datasheet says otherwise), split between its models as you choose. No model can exceed its starting SP. **Damage That Ignores Shields:**
Damage from [DEVASTATING WOUNDS] and psychic attacks ignores SP.

At the start of any phase, until the end of the phase, improve this unit's Ld characteristic by 2 and re-roll battle-shock rolls made for it. **Yanme'e Doctrines**

At the start of your Shooting or Fight phase, until the end of the phase, add 1 to hit rolls for attacks made by models in this unit while it contains 5 or more models. **Predatory Descent:**
At the start of your Charge or Fight phase, until the end of the phase, add 1 to charge rolls made for this unit and melee weapons equipped by its models have [SUSTAINED HITS 1]. **Fade Into Shadow:**
At the start of your opponent's Shooting phase, until the end of the phase, this unit has the Stealth ability.

sharedRules.name: Supercombine
sharedRules.description: After this unit has made its hit rolls, for every three hits scored against the same target with [SUPERCOMBINE] weapons, that target suffers 1 mortal wound. Extra hits from [SUSTAINED HITS] count.

sharedRules.name: Plasma
sharedRules.description:
​

**Plasma (DX) / Plasma (APX):**
Each time an attack made with this weapon scores a critical hit, add X to that attack's D characteristic (Plasma (DX)) or improve its AP characteristic by X (Plasma (APX)). Extra hits from [SUSTAINED HITS] do not benefit.

sharedRules.name: Siegebreaker
sharedRules.description: Each time an attack made with this weapon scores a critical hit, invulnerable saves cannot be used against that attack. Extra hits from [SUSTAINED HITS] do not benefit.

sharedRules.name: Wargear Costs
sharedRules.description: Weapon exchanges are free, except: Fuel Rod, Skewer, two Needlers, Gravity Hammer and Twin-linked Energy Swords (+10 pts each) and Wrist Shield (+5 pts). A datasheet's own limits and costs take precedence.

sharedRules.name: The Great Journey — Proclaim the Sacred Path / 1 CP
sharedRules.description:
*Strategic Ploy Stratagem* **When**
Start of any phase, just after a friendly SAN'SHYUUM model issues a Fanatical Doctrine. **Target**
That SAN'SHYUUM model's unit. **Effect**
Select one additional friendly COVENANT INFANTRY unit within range of that model's Voice of the Great Journey ability. Until the end of the phase, that additional unit is affected by the same Fanatical Doctrine.

sharedRules.name: The Great Journey — Fevered Pilgrimage / 1 CP
sharedRules.description:
*Battle Tactic Stratagem* **When**
Your Movement phase, when a friendly COVENANT INFANTRY unit affected by a Fanatical Doctrine is selected to move. **Target**
That COVENANT INFANTRY unit. **Effect**
Until the end of the turn, your unit is eligible to shoot and declare a charge in a turn in which it made an advance move.

sharedRules.name: The Great Journey — Cleanse the Sacred Ground / 1 CP
sharedRules.description:
*Battle Tactic Stratagem* **When**
Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase, when a friendly COVENANT INFANTRY unit affected by a Fanatical Doctrine is selected to attack. **Target**
That COVENANT INFANTRY unit. **Effect**
Until the end of the phase, improve the AP characteristic of attacks made by models in your unit by 1 when they target an enemy unit within range of an objective marker.

sharedRules.name: The Great Journey — Armoured by Conviction / 1 CP
sharedRules.description:
*Strategic Ploy Stratagem* **When**
Your opponent's Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit selects a friendly COVENANT INFANTRY unit affected by a Fanatical Doctrine as the target of one or more attacks. **Target**
That COVENANT INFANTRY unit. **Effect**
Until the attacking unit has finished making its attacks, worsen the AP characteristic of those attacks by 1.

sharedRules.name: The Great Journey — Living Bulwark / 1 CP
sharedRules.description:
*Strategic Ploy Stratagem* **When**
Your opponent's Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit selects a friendly unattached SAN'SHYUUM CHARACTER unit as the target of one or more attacks. **Target**
That SAN'SHYUUM unit and one friendly non-CHARACTER COVENANT INFANTRY unit within 3" of it. **Effect**
Each time one of those attacks targets your SAN'SHYUUM unit, if the selected COVENANT INFANTRY unit is an eligible target for that attack, change that attack's target to the selected COVENANT INFANTRY unit.

sharedRules.name: The Great Journey — Unquestioning Obedience / 1 CP
sharedRules.description:
*Epic Deed Stratagem* **When**
Just after a friendly COVENANT INFANTRY unit within 6" of a friendly SAN'SHYUUM model fails a battle-shock roll. **Target**
That COVENANT INFANTRY unit. **Effect**
Your unit suffers D3 mortal wounds, and that battle-shock roll is treated as having been passed.

sharedRules.name: Covenant Expeditionary Force — Coordinated Targeting / 1 CP
sharedRules.description:
*Strategic Ploy Stratagem* **When**
Start of your Shooting phase or the Fight phase. **Target**
One enemy unit within 18" of and visible to at least one friendly Line Element and at least one friendly Support Element. **Effect**
Until the end of the phase, that enemy unit is both Designated and Suppressed.

sharedRules.name: Covenant Expeditionary Force — Eliminate Priority Target / 1 CP
sharedRules.description:
*Battle Tactic Stratagem* **When**
Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after a friendly COVENANT unit is selected to make attacks. **Target**
That COVENANT unit and one enemy unit that is both Designated and Suppressed. **Effect**
Until the end of the phase, add 1 to wound rolls for attacks made by your unit against that enemy unit.

sharedRules.name: Covenant Expeditionary Force — Combat Deployment / 1 CP
sharedRules.description:
*Strategic Ploy Stratagem* **When**
Your Movement phase, just after a friendly COVENANT TRANSPORT unit, excluding Aircraft, ends a normal move. **Target**
That Transport and one friendly COVENANT INFANTRY unit that started the phase embarked within it and remains embarked. **Effect**
Your INFANTRY unit can immediately disembark. It cannot declare a charge this turn.

sharedRules.name: Covenant Expeditionary Force — Armoured Screen / 1 CP
sharedRules.description:
*Strategic Ploy Stratagem* **When**
Your opponent's Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit selects a friendly Line Element as the target of one or more attacks. **Target**
That Line Element, provided it is within 3" of one or more friendly Support Elements. **Effect**
Until the attacking unit has finished making its attacks, worsen the AP characteristic of attacks allocated to your unit by 1.

sharedRules.name: Covenant Expeditionary Force — Emergency Field Repairs / 1 CP
sharedRules.description:
*Epic Deed Stratagem* **When**
Your Command phase. **Target**
One friendly COVENANT VEHICLE or COVENANT MONSTER unit, excluding TITANIC units, within 6" of a friendly COVENANT INFANTRY unit. **Effect**
Select one model in the target unit. It regains D3 lost wounds and up to D3 lost SP.

sharedRules.name: Covenant Expeditionary Force — Tactical Withdrawal / 1 CP
sharedRules.description:
*Battle Tactic Stratagem* **When**
Your Movement phase, just after a friendly Line Element or Support Element is selected to make a fall-back move. **Target**
That unit. **Effect**
Until the end of the turn, your unit is eligible to shoot after making a fall-back move. If it ends that fall-back move within 6" of a friendly unit belonging to the other type of Element, it is also eligible to declare a charge this turn.

sharedRules.name: Sangheili Warhost — Relentless Pursuit / 1 CP
sharedRules.description:
*Strategic Ploy Stratagem* **When**
Your Movement phase, just after a SANGHEILI INFANTRY or SANGHEILI MOUNTED unit is selected to make an advance move. **Target**
That SANGHEILI unit. **Effect**
Until the end of the turn, your unit is eligible to declare a charge after making an advance move. If your unit is Exultant, do not make an advance roll; instead add 6" to its M characteristic until the end of the phase.

sharedRules.name: Sangheili Warhost — The Killing Stroke / 1 CP
sharedRules.description:
*Battle Tactic Stratagem* **When**
Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after a SANGHEILI unit is selected to shoot or fight. **Target**
That SANGHEILI unit. **Effect**
Until the end of the phase, add 1 to wound rolls for attacks made by your unit against your Worthy Foe. If your unit is Exultant, also improve the AP characteristic of those attacks by 1.

sharedRules.name: Sangheili Warhost — Honour Duel / 1 CP
sharedRules.description:
*Epic Deed Stratagem* **When**
Start of the Fight phase. **Target**
One SANGHEILI CHARACTER unit within engagement range of one or more enemy CHARACTER units. **Effect**
Select one SANGHEILI CHARACTER model in your unit and one enemy CHARACTER model within engagement range of it. Your opponent accepts or refuses the duel. ■ Accepted: until both models have fought, each can only make melee attacks against the other, and other attacks cannot be allocated to either of them. If either would be reduced to 0 wounds by the other before it has fought, it is left with 1 wound and is destroyed after it has fought. If your unit is Exultant, add 1 to the D characteristic of your model's melee weapons. ■ Refused: until the end of the phase, models in your unit can re-roll hit and wound rolls for melee attacks that target that enemy CHARACTER's unit.

sharedRules.name: Sangheili Warhost — Shields Unbroken / 1 CP
sharedRules.description:
*Strategic Ploy Stratagem* **When**
Your opponent's Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit selects a SANGHEILI unit as the target of one or more attacks. **Target**
That SANGHEILI unit. **Effect**
Until the attacking unit has finished making its attacks, Shield Saves made for models in your unit succeed on a 2+. If your unit is Exultant, reduce this Stratagem's CP cost by 1CP.

sharedRules.name: Sangheili Warhost — Death Before Dishonour / 1 CP
sharedRules.description:
*Strategic Ploy Stratagem* **When**
Fight phase, just after an enemy unit selects a SANGHEILI unit as the target of one or more attacks. **Target**
That SANGHEILI unit. **Effect**
Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit is destroyed before it has fought, roll one D6. On a 4+, do not remove it. After the attacking unit finishes making its attacks, that model can fight and is then removed. If your unit is Exultant, this succeeds on a 3+.

sharedRules.name: Sangheili Warhost — Claim the Trophy / 1 CP
sharedRules.description:
*Strategic Ploy Stratagem* **When**
Fight phase, just after a SANGHEILI unit has fought and destroyed one or more enemy units, before it consolidates. **Target**
That SANGHEILI unit. **Effect**
When your unit consolidates, its models can move up to 6" instead of 3" and must end closer to the closest enemy unit or closest objective marker. If your unit is Exultant, reduce this Stratagem's CP cost by 1CP.

sharedRules.name: Jiralhanae Warpack — Pin the Prey / 1 CP
sharedRules.description:
*Strategic Ploy Stratagem* **When**
End of your opponent's Movement phase. **Target**
One friendly unengaged JIRALHANAE INFANTRY or JIRALHANAE MOUNTED unit within 12" of one or more enemy units that ended a normal, advance or fall-back move this phase. **Effect**
Resolve a charge with your unit. When selecting charge targets, you can only select enemy units that ended a normal, advance or fall-back move this phase.

sharedRules.name: Jiralhanae Warpack — Crushing Envelopment / 1 CP
sharedRules.description:
*Battle Tactic Stratagem* **When**
Fight phase, when a JIRALHANAE unit is selected to fight. **Target**
That unit and one enemy unit within engagement range of another friendly COVENANT unit. **Effect**
Until the end of the phase, add 1 to wound rolls for melee attacks made by your unit against that enemy unit.

sharedRules.name: Jiralhanae Warpack — Pack-Covered Advance / 1 CP
sharedRules.description:
*Strategic Ploy Stratagem* **When**
Your opponent's Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit selects a JIRALHANAE unit as the target of one or more attacks. **Target**
That JIRALHANAE unit, provided it is within 3" of another friendly COVENANT unit. **Effect**
Until the attacking unit has finished making its attacks, worsen the AP characteristic of those attacks by 1.

sharedRules.name: Jiralhanae Warpack — Seize the Opening / 1 CP
sharedRules.description:
*Strategic Ploy Stratagem* **When**
Just after another friendly COVENANT unit destroys an enemy unit in the Shooting or Fight phase. **Target**
One JIRALHANAE unit within 6" of that friendly COVENANT unit. **Effect**
Your unit can make a normal move of up to D6". It cannot end that move within engagement range of an enemy unit.

sharedRules.name: Jiralhanae Warpack — Hold Them Fast / 1 CP
sharedRules.description:
*Strategic Ploy Stratagem* **When**
Your opponent's Movement phase, when an enemy unit within engagement range of a JIRALHANAE unit is selected to make a fall-back move. **Target**
That JIRALHANAE unit. **Effect**
Roll one D6. On a 3+, that enemy unit cannot make a fall-back move this phase and suffers D3 mortal wounds.

sharedRules.name: Jiralhanae Warpack — Brutal Efficiency / 1 CP
sharedRules.description:
*Strategic Ploy Stratagem* **When**
Fight phase, just after a JIRALHANAE unit destroys an enemy unit, before it consolidates. **Target**
That JIRALHANAE unit. **Effect**
When your unit consolidates, its models can move up to 6" instead of 3" and must end closer to the closest enemy unit or closest objective marker.

sharedRules.name: Yig-Yar Hunting Talon — Break the Firing Solution / 1 CP
sharedRules.description:
*Strategic Ploy Stratagem* **When**
Your opponent's Shooting phase, when a YIG-YAR unit makes a Scuttle to Cover move. **Target**
That YIG-YAR unit. **Effect**
Do not roll to determine the distance of that move. Your unit can move up to 8" instead and can move through friendly models, but cannot end on top of them.

sharedRules.name: Yig-Yar Hunting Talon — Return Fire / 1 CP
sharedRules.description:
*Battle Tactic Stratagem* **When**
Your opponent's Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has shot. **Target**
One YIG-YAR unit that was targeted by one or more of those attacks and is eligible to shoot. **Effect**
Your unit shoots using Snap Shooting, but can only target that enemy unit.

sharedRules.name: Yig-Yar Hunting Talon — Crossfire Quarry / 1 CP
sharedRules.description:
*Battle Tactic Stratagem* **When**
Your Shooting phase, when a YIG-YAR unit is selected to shoot. **Target**
That unit and one enemy unit visible to another friendly YIG-YAR unit. **Effect**
Until the end of the phase, improve the AP characteristic of ranged attacks made by your unit against that enemy unit by 1.

sharedRules.name: Yig-Yar Hunting Talon — Hidden Firing Lanes / 1 CP
sharedRules.description:
*Strategic Ploy Stratagem* **When**
Your Shooting phase, when a YIG-YAR INFANTRY unit wholly within a terrain feature is selected to shoot. **Target**
That unit. **Effect**
Until the end of the phase, ranged weapons equipped by models in your unit have [LETHAL HITS].

sharedRules.name: Yig-Yar Hunting Talon — Snare the Advance / 1 CP
sharedRules.description:
*Strategic Ploy Stratagem* **When**
Your opponent's Charge phase, just after an enemy unit declares a charge against a YIG-YAR INFANTRY unit. **Target**
That YIG-YAR unit. **Effect**
Until the end of the phase, subtract 2 from charge rolls made for that enemy unit.

sharedRules.name: Yig-Yar Hunting Talon — Vanish Into the Rocks / 1 CP
sharedRules.description:
*Strategic Ploy Stratagem* **When**
End of your opponent's Fight phase. **Target**
One YIG-YAR INFANTRY unit that is unengaged. **Effect**
Remove your unit from the battlefield and place it into strategic reserves.

sharedRules.name: Fleetborne Invasion — Launch the Second Wave / 1 CP
sharedRules.description:
*Strategic Ploy Stratagem* **When**
Your Movement phase, just after an empty Phantom disembarks from a Lich or Kraken. **Target**
That Lich or Kraken, that Phantom, and any number of COVENANT INFANTRY units embarked within the Lich or Kraken. **Effect**
Select any number of the targeted INFANTRY units, one at a time. Transfer each selected unit into the Phantom until its Transport capacity is filled. Any unit that cannot fit remains embarked within the original Invasion Vessel.

sharedRules.name: Fleetborne Invasion — Renewed Glassing Authorisation / 2 CP
sharedRules.description:
*Epic Deed Stratagem* **When**
Your Shooting phase, when a Sangheili Shipmaster model that has already used Glassing Beam is selected to use that ability. **Target**
That Sangheili Shipmaster model. **Effect**
The bearer can use Glassing Beam one additional time this battle. **Restrictions**
You cannot use this Stratagem more than once per battle.

sharedRules.name: Fleetborne Invasion — Orbital Descent Vector / 1 CP
sharedRules.description:
*Strategic Ploy Stratagem* **When**
Your Movement phase, just after an Invasion Vessel is set up from reserves. **Target**
That Invasion Vessel. **Effect**
Your unit can make a normal move of up to 8", but cannot end that move within 6" of any enemy model.

sharedRules.name: Fleetborne Invasion — Return to the Fleet / 1 CP
sharedRules.description:
*Strategic Ploy Stratagem* **When**
End of the Fight phase. **Target**
One Landing Force INFANTRY unit within 6" of a friendly Invasion Vessel and unengaged. **Effect**
Your unit can immediately embark within that Invasion Vessel, even if that Invasion Vessel made a normal move this turn.

sharedRules.name: Fleetborne Invasion — Hold the Beachhead / 1 CP
sharedRules.description:
*Strategic Ploy Stratagem* **When**
Your opponent's Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit selects a Landing Force unit as the target of one or more attacks. **Target**
That Landing Force unit, provided it is within 6" of a friendly Invasion Vessel. **Effect**
Until the attacking unit has finished making its attacks, worsen the AP characteristic of those attacks by 1.

sharedRules.name: Fleetborne Invasion — Clear the Landing Zone / 1 CP
sharedRules.description:
*Battle Tactic Stratagem* **When**
Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase, when a Landing Force or Invasion Vessel unit is selected to attack. **Target**
That unit and one enemy unit within range of an objective marker. **Effect**
Until the end of the phase, add 1 to wound rolls for attacks made by your unit against that enemy unit.

sharedRules.name: Shadow Cell — Perfect Ambush / 1 CP
sharedRules.description:
*Battle Tactic Stratagem* **When**
Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase, when a Concealed Shadow Cell unit is selected to shoot or fight. **Target**
That Shadow Cell unit. **Effect**
Until the end of the phase, weapons equipped by models in your unit have [LETHAL HITS]. Ranged weapons equipped by those models also have [IGNORES COVER].

sharedRules.name: Shadow Cell — Vanish Without Trace / 1 CP
sharedRules.description:
*Strategic Ploy Stratagem* **When**
Just after a Shadow Cell unit has shot or fought. **Target**
That unit, provided it is unengaged. **Effect**
Your unit becomes Concealed. If used after your unit shot, it cannot declare a charge this turn.

sharedRules.name: Shadow Cell — Remote Sabotage / 1 CP
sharedRules.description:
*Strategic Ploy Stratagem* **When**
End of your opponent's Movement phase. **Target**
One Shadow Cell unit within 6" of an enemy VEHICLE or FORTIFICATION unit. **Effect**
Select one such enemy unit. It suffers D3 mortal wounds and must make a battle-shock roll.

sharedRules.name: Armored Spearhead — Power to Forward Shields / 1 CP
sharedRules.description:
*Strategic Ploy Stratagem* **When**
Your opponent's Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit selects an Armored Spearhead unit as the target of one or more attacks. **Target**
That unit, provided it is within 6" of another friendly Armored Spearhead unit. **Effect**
Until the attacking unit has finished making its attacks, Shield Saves made for models in your unit succeed on a 2+.

sharedRules.name: Armored Spearhead — Concentrated Plasma Fire / 1 CP
sharedRules.description:
*Battle Tactic Stratagem* **When**
Your Shooting phase, when an Armored Spearhead unit is selected to shoot. **Target**
That unit and one enemy unit hit by a different friendly Armored Spearhead unit this phase. **Effect**
Until the end of the phase, improve the AP characteristic of attacks made by your unit against that enemy unit by 1.

sharedRules.name: Armored Spearhead — Gravitic Breakthrough / 1 CP
sharedRules.description:
*Strategic Ploy Stratagem* **When**
Your Movement phase, when an Armored Spearhead unit is selected to make a normal or advance move. **Target**
That unit. **Effect**
Until the end of that move, models in your unit can move horizontally through other models, excluding TITANIC models, and through terrain features 4" or less in height. They cannot end that move on another model or within engagement range of an enemy unit.

sharedRules.name: Grunt Levy — Massed Plasma Volley / 1 CP
sharedRules.description:
*Battle Tactic Stratagem* **When**
Your Shooting phase, when an UNGGOY INFANTRY unit is selected to shoot. **Target**
That unit. **Effect**
Until the end of the phase, ranged weapons equipped by UNGGOY models in your unit have [LETHAL HITS].

sharedRules.name: Grunt Levy — Expendable Screen / 1 CP
sharedRules.description:
*Strategic Ploy Stratagem* **When**
Your opponent's Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit selects a friendly non-UNGGOY COVENANT INFANTRY unit as the target of one or more attacks. **Target**
That COVENANT INFANTRY unit and one friendly Grunt Cadre within 3" of it. **Effect**
Until the attacking unit has finished making its attacks, each time one of those attacks targets your COVENANT INFANTRY unit, if the selected Grunt Cadre is an eligible target, change that attack's target to the Grunt Cadre.

sharedRules.name: Grunt Levy — More Where They Came From / 1 CP
sharedRules.description:
*Strategic Ploy Stratagem* **When**
Your Command phase, just after resolving Replacement Drafts. **Target**
One different Grunt Cadre unit that is below starting strength. **Effect**
Return up to D3+1 destroyed Unggoy Warrior models to that unit.

sharedRules.name: Drone Hive Swarm — Replenish the Brood / 1 CP
sharedRules.description:
*Strategic Ploy Stratagem* **When**
Your Command phase. **Target**
One DRONE SWARM unit that is below starting strength. **Effect**
Return up to D3+2 destroyed Yanme'e Drone models to that unit. A Yanme'e Major cannot be returned. **Restrictions**
The same unit can only be targeted once per battle.

sharedRules.name: Drone Hive Swarm — Obscuring Swarm / 1 CP
sharedRules.description:
*Strategic Ploy Stratagem* **When**
Your opponent's Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit selects a friendly COVENANT unit within 3" of a Drone Swarm as the target of one or more attacks. **Target**
That COVENANT unit and that Drone Swarm. **Effect**
Until the attacking unit has finished making its attacks, subtract 1 from hit rolls made against the selected COVENANT unit. After those attacks are resolved, the Drone Swarm suffers D3 mortal wounds.

sharedRules.name: Drone Hive Swarm — Attack From Every Angle / 1 CP
sharedRules.description:
*Battle Tactic Stratagem* **When**
Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase, when a Drone Swarm is selected to shoot or fight. **Target**
That unit and one enemy unit within 6" of a different friendly Drone Swarm. **Effect**
Until the end of the phase, add 1 to wound rolls for attacks made by your unit against that enemy unit.

sharedRules.name: Bonded Colony — Interlocking Shields / 1 CP
sharedRules.description:
*Strategic Ploy Stratagem* **When**
Your opponent's Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit selects a MGALEKGOLO unit as the target of one or more attacks. **Target**
That unit, provided it is within 6" of its Bondmate. **Effect**
Until the attacking unit has finished making its attacks, worsen the AP characteristic of those attacks by 1.

sharedRules.name: Bonded Colony — Synchronized Destruction / 1 CP
sharedRules.description:
*Battle Tactic Stratagem* **When**
Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase, when a MGALEKGOLO unit is selected to shoot or fight. **Target**
That unit and one enemy unit hit by its Bondmate this phase. **Effect**
Until the end of the phase, add 1 to wound rolls for attacks made by your unit against that enemy unit.

sharedRules.name: Bonded Colony — Wrath of the Bereaved / 1 CP
sharedRules.description:
*Epic Deed Stratagem* **When**
Just after an enemy unit destroys a MGALEKGOLO unit's Bondmate. **Target**
The surviving MGALEKGOLO unit. **Effect**
Until the end of your next turn, add 1 to Hit and wound rolls for attacks made by your unit against the enemy unit that destroyed its Bondmate.

sharedRules.name: Engineer Reclamation Detail — Field-fabricated Emplacement / 1 CP
sharedRules.description:
*Strategic Ploy Stratagem* **When**
End of your Movement phase. **Target**
One HURAGOK unit within 3" of a Reclamation marker. **Effect**
Remove that marker. Set up one new Covenant Deployable Turret unit at starting strength wholly within 3" of your Huragok and more than 3" from all enemy models. **Restrictions**
You cannot use this Stratagem more than once per battle.

sharedRules.name: Engineer Reclamation Detail — Last-second Stabilisation / 1 CP
sharedRules.description:
*Epic Deed Stratagem* **When**
Any phase, just after an enemy unit finishes making attacks that destroyed a friendly non-TITANIC COVENANT VEHICLE or FORTIFICATION unit within 3" of a friendly HURAGOK model. **Target**
That destroyed unit and one such HURAGOK unit. **Effect**
Roll one D6. On a 3+, return one destroyed model from the target unit to the battlefield as close as possible to where it was destroyed and outside engagement range of enemy models. It has 1 wound remaining and 0 SP. **Restrictions**
You cannot use this Stratagem more than once per battle.

sharedRules.name: Engineer Reclamation Detail — Emergency Shield Reboot / 1 CP
sharedRules.description:
*Strategic Ploy Stratagem* **When**
Your opponent's Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit selects a friendly COVENANT VEHICLE or FORTIFICATION unit as the target of one or more attacks. **Target**
That unit, provided one of its models has a starting SP characteristic greater than 0, currently has 0 SP, and is within 6" of a friendly HURAGOK model. **Effect**
Before those attacks are resolved, one model in your unit regains up to D3+1 lost SP.
